output.why: The proposed change to add a third sludge sump transfer pump (1W+2S) directly conflicts with the technical specification (Clause 7.1.26), Datasheet A (Item 34), and the ETP P&ID (PE-DG-508-164-W001), which all mandate two (2x100%, 1W+1S) pumps. Furthermore, the RCC Sludge Sump (E14) civil works are in BHEL's scope and are sized for two pumps.
